blocks.text: Complex ion mein markazi dhaat ka ion gird ke electron dene wale species se jura hota hai. Dhaat ka ion Lewis acid (electron jora lene wala) aur akele joron (lone pairs) wale molecules ya ions, jaise H2O, NH3, Cl- aur OH-, Lewis bases ka kaam karte hain. Dhaat ke ion se coordinate bonds ki tadaad coordination number hai; aam qeematein 2, 4 aur 6 hain.

Complex banna transition metals mein zyada aam hai jin ke paas dastiyab d orbitals hain, lekin Group 2 ions bhi complexes bana sakte hain, khaas kar group ke oopar wale. Chhote ions ki charge density zyada hoti aur woh donors ko behtar kheenchte hain, aur Group 2 ke sab ions par +2 charge hota hai.

blocks.alt: Baen: octahedral [Mg(H2O)6]2+ ion, beech mein hara Mg aur gird chhe OH2 groups, do wedge aur do hashed bonds se. Daen: calcium ion chhe donor atoms, do N aur chaar O, ke halqe ke beech, jinhein aik jamni zanjeer jorti hai jo aik EDTA ligand hai.
blocks.caption: Hydrated magnesium ion aur calcium-EDTA chelate (is topic ke liye asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Complex ion mein markazi dhaat ka ion electron jora dene walon (ligands) se coordinate bonds ke zariye jura hota hai; aise bonds ki tadaad coordination number hai. Group 2 ions transition dhaaton ke ions se kam complex banate hain, chhote ions sab se aasani se. Paani mein ions hydrated hote hain: Be2+ [Be(H2O)4]2+ (coordination number 4) aur Mg2+ octahedral [Mg(H2O)6]2+ (coordination number 6) banata hai. Kai donor atoms wala ligand aik ion ko kai taraf se pakar kar halqe banata hai: EDTA chhe donor jore laga kar Ca2+ ko thaamta hai, isi tarah woh bhari paani narm aur jism se dhaatein nikalta hai.

items: Hydrated ions: Group 2 ke namak ghulne par ions hydrate hote hain, paani electron jora dene wala. Sab se chhota Be2+ [Be(H2O)4]2+ (coordination number 4) banata; Mg2+ [Mg(H2O)6]2+ (coordination number 6); Ca2+, Sr2+ aur Ba2+ ka bhi zyada tar coordination number 6, neeche amal kamzor.

Chelates: ions, khaas kar chhote, aise donors se mustahkam complexes banate hain jin ke kai donor jore hon, jo aik hi ion se kai bonds bana kar halqe banate hain. Ca2+ chhe jore dene wale EDTA (ethylenediaminetetraacetic acid) se halqa daar complex banata hai: Ca2+ + EDTA4- -> [Ca(EDTA)]2-. EDTA Ca2+ aur Mg2+ nikal kar paani narm karne, aur dawa mein jism se zehreeli dhaatein nikalne mein use hota hai.

blocks.prompt: MgSO4 BaSO4 ke muqable mein aasani se kyun ghulta hai?
blocks.explanation: Chhote Mg2+ ion ki hydration enthalpy kaheen zyada manfi hai, jab ke bare anion wale sulphates ki lattice enthalpy kam badalti hai; is liye tawanai ka tawazun MgSO4 ke ghulne ke haq mein hai, BaSO4 ke nahi.

items: Complex ion: markazi dhaat ion + ligands; coordination number = coordinate bonds ki tadaad.
[Be(H2O)4]2+ (4), [Mg(H2O)6]2+ (6); EDTA Ca2+ ko chelate karta (paani narm, dawa).
